content.value_statement: Low-quality screenshots and compressed images can reduce trust in documentation, presentations, and social posts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through clear image enhancement requests.
actual_capabilities: Improves screenshot quality for blog posts and documentation.
Upscales low-resolution images for larger displays.
Sharpens blurry images and improves edge clarity.
Reduces visible compression artifacts and noise.
Optimizes image requests for web, print, and social media.
Supports batch enhancement requests for folders of images.
limitations: The skill does not include a specific image processing script or library.
Final quality depends on detail present in the source image.
Severe blur or unreadable text may not be recoverable.
Batch work needs clear folder scope and output naming rules.

use_cases.title: Prepare Documentation Screenshots
use_cases.description: Improve UI screenshots before adding them to product guides or release notes.

use_cases.title: Polish Presentation Images
use_cases.description: Upscale and sharpen visuals so they remain clear on large screens.

use_cases.title: Optimize Social Media Graphics
use_cases.description: Adjust image clarity and format for posts on social platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance One Screenshot
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the quality of screenshot.png. Preserve the original file and save an enhanced copy with a clear filename.

prompt_templates.title: Sharpen Documentation Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused request for readable interface details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Sharpen this UI screenshot for documentation. Prioritize readable text, clean edges, and minimal compression artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize for a Platform
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with a target channel.
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this image for LinkedIn. Improve clarity, choose a suitable output format, and keep the file size practical.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Enhancement Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance all PNG images in this folder. Keep originals, create enhanced copies, and summarize the changes for each file.

output_examples.input: Improve the quality of screenshot-2024.png for a product blog post.
output_examples.output: The enhanced copy is sharper, easier to read, and ready for publication. The original image remains unchanged.

output_examples.input: Upscale a low-resolution dashboard image for a presentation.
output_examples.output: The image is prepared at a higher resolution with clearer labels and cleaner edges for large-screen viewing.

output_examples.input: Clean up all PNG screenshots in a documentation folder.
output: Each enhanced image receives a distinct filename.
A short summary lists the main quality improvements.

best_practices: Provide the image path, target use, desired format, and output size.
Ask to preserve originals and use clear enhanced filenames.
Specify the platform or medium when optimizing for social, web, print, or slides.
anti_patterns: Do not request enhancement of broad folders without a clear file scope.
Do not expect unreadable text or severe blur to become fully accurate.
Do not overwrite original images without a verified backup plan.

faq.question: What images work best with this skill?
faq.answer: It works best with screenshots, interface images, and digital graphics that need clearer text or edges.

faq.question: Can it process multiple images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes batch enhancement prompts for folders when the file scope is clearly defined.

faq.question: Does it preserve original files?
faq.answer: The skill recommends preserving originals. Ask for enhanced copies with distinct filenames.

faq.question: Which output formats should I request?
faq.answer: Use PNG when quality matters most. Use JPG when smaller files are more important.

faq.question: Can it upscale images to 4K?
faq.answer: You can request 4K upscaling. Results depend on the source resolution and visible detail.

faq.question: Does the skill require network access?
faq.answer: No evidence found in SKILL.md that network access is required. The runtime tool choice controls processing.
